changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment: Seed one development login per Phase 1 role (password: admin)
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO jhi_user ( id, login, password_hash, first_name, last_name, email, activated, lang_key, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date ) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), v.login, h.password_hash, v.first_name, v.last_name, v.email, true, 'en', 'system', now(), 'system', now() FROM (VALUES ('reception', 'Reception', 'Desk', 'reception@localhost'), ('nurse', 'Triage', 'Nurse', 'nurse@localhost'), ('doctor', 'Attending', 'Doctor', 'doctor@localhost'), ('lab', 'Laboratory', 'Technician','lab@localhost'), ('radiology', 'Radiology', 'Technician','radiology@localhost'), ('pharmacy', 'Pharmacy', 'Dispenser', 'pharmacy@localhost'), ('finance', 'Finance', 'Cashier', 'finance@localhost'), ('superadmin', 'Super', 'Admin', 'superadmin@localhost') ) AS v(login, first_name, last_name, email) CROSS JOIN (VALUES -- The BCrypt hash of 'admin', copied from the stock admin row in user.csv. One hash for -- every development account, so there is one password to remember. Development only. ('$2a$10$gSAhZrxMllrbgj/kkK9UceBPpChGWJA7SYIb1Mqo.n5aNLq1/oRrC') ) AS h(password_hash) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user existing WHERE existing.login = v.login);
-- ROLE_USER alongside each hospital role, mirroring how the stock admin row carries -- ROLE_ADMIN and ROLE_USER together. It grants nothing but /api/account, which the login -- flow needs; every hospital endpoint is named explicitly in the RBAC table. INSERT INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT u.id, v.authority_name FROM (VALUES ('reception', 'ROLE_RECEPTION'), ('reception', 'ROLE_USER'), ('nurse', 'ROLE_NURSE'), ('nurse', 'ROLE_USER'), ('doctor', 'ROLE_DOCTOR'), ('doctor', 'ROLE_USER'), ('lab', 'ROLE_LAB'), ('lab', 'ROLE_USER'), ('radiology', 'ROLE_RADIOLOGY'), ('radiology', 'ROLE_USER'), ('pharmacy', 'ROLE_PHARMACY'), ('pharmacy', 'ROLE_USER'), ('finance', 'ROLE_FINANCE'), ('finance', 'ROLE_USER'), ('superadmin', 'ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN'), ('superadmin', 'ROLE_USER') ) AS v(login, authority_name) INNER JOIN jhi_user u ON u.login = v.login ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
